prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: OPAQUE ground-material texture atlas for original painterly fantasy RPG Ash & Aether. Create ONE wide landscape image in EXACT 2:1 aspect ratio, arranged as FOUR columns by TWO rows of EIGHT flat square material samples. Each square is filled edge-to-edge with continuous fine material texture: NO gutters, borders, frames, labels, words, numbering or empty space. Camera is straight overhead, FLAT material reference with zero horizon and no depth perspective. These are small-scale natural ground SURFACES, NOT objects or scenery. Medium: restrained finely hand-painted material art, softly varied color, realistic tiny grains and fibers, low contrast, diffuse even lighting, extremely minimal shadows. Every square has broadly uniform brightness across its full surface; NO central spotlight, vignette, dark corners, big decorative motifs or dramatic highlights. Materials in exact order TOP ROW left-to-right: 1) dense natural green moss and tiny clover with hints of short crushed meadow grass, fine ground-level botanical texture; 2) water-dark alluvial mud with tiny rounded pebbles, muted petrol grey-green, occasional shallow damp sheen but no puddle outline; 3) warm ochre sand with very fine soft wind ripples and faint scattered grains, smooth and calm; 4) desaturated blue-slate gravel/rubble ground with small mineral grains and low pale lichen, no large boulders. BOTTOM ROW left-to-right: 5) pale blue-slate frost and fine snow crust, subtle crystalline mottling, diffuse and soft, no giant ice crystals; 6) muted violet-blue fungal soil with a delicate low pale mycelium network, fine subtle filaments, no mushrooms or tall plants; 7) cooling charcoal volcanic clinker ground in warm grey and restrained rust, tiny porous grains, NO glowing lava; 8) worn pale limestone/marble mosaic ground with very small irregular fragments and pale dust in seams, soft low-contrast mineral texture, no large regular geometric pattern. Every sample is a natural repeatable fine texture at a believable human ground scale, suitable as a subtle 0.4-alpha overlay behind game characters. Exact 4x2 equal grid and eight distinct materials; do not blend materials across boundaries. No people, buildings, props, roots, animals, text, symbols, apparent shadows from objects, photo collage borders or transparency.
